block.godforge.forge_of_the_gods.tooltip: §7§oThe Forge of the Gods(GORGE) is an unfathomably powerful structure built around a stabilized neutron star.
§7§obut one thing is certain: its power can replace nearly any conventional process.
§7§oMagmatter, Redux, and Mellion can only be found
§7§owhere ordinary matter meets degenerate neutron matter on the neutron star's surface.
§7§oGORGE allows these materials to be produced more efficiently,
§7§oeliminating the need for conventional DTPF-based production methods.
§7§oThese materials can barely exist outside the Foundry's extreme conditions,
§7§obut continued research may one day make their extraction possible.
§7§oThough, one must wonder... would there even be a reason to?
§bModules:§7 up to 16 Module of the Gods on the beam shaft. Hold a §bModule of the Gods Blueprint§7 near the forge to see where.
§bExoticizer Mode:§7 each module adds +50%% recipe time and +100%% output.
§bOther modes:§7 Parallel Hatch parallels x module count, and each module overclocks a little (16 modules = 2x speed, no extra EU/t).
block.godforge.module_of_the_gods.toolti: §7A Module of the Gods has no controller and does nothing on its own; the Forge of the Gods counts it.
§bHold this:§7 the forge's 16 module slots light up (§agreen§7 done, §eyellow§7 empty, §bcyan§7 next) and the next module appears as ghost blocks.
§bRight-click the cyan casing:§7 builds that module from blocks in your inventory. The blueprint itself is not consumed.
§7Exoticizer Mode: +50%% time, +100%% output per module. Other modes: Parallel Hatch x module count, up to 2x speed.
